description: Patch or submit a consumer-prefill homeowners or umbrella handoff in chat. Reuse uid and the latest intake_access_token from the previous successful Coverage Cat response on each follow-up. MCP 2026-07-28 is stateless and requires that token. Legacy MCP hosts may also preserve hidden shopper session authorization. Keep tokens private and stay on this same MCP follow-up tool. Stay on the default consumer-operated subset. For homeowners, use `intake` to add context-backed or property-backed answers while keeping the user out of a questionnaire until the one-time review, and after submission use `message_reply` plus optional `reply_to_message_id` for insurer or shopper follow-up surfaced under `conversation.messages`. For umbrella, use the staged review turn to send only explicitly missing shopper-owned details plus corrections, set `confirm_submission` only on that final review confirmation, do not send vehicles rows on this pre-submit patch, and do not ask for umbrella credit consent here. Normalize shopper birthdays from MM-DD-YYYY to YYYY-MM-DD, and tell the shopper the application is not submitted yet until you actually submit it. Returns the same follow-up payload as `consumer_intake_issues` for the updated intake.

confirm_submission.description: Set true only on the single final review turn.

field_estimates.description: Umbrella provenance for values in this same patch that you inferred rather than heard from the shopper, one row per inferred value. Add rows only when you are certain each field path matches a current umbrella review field.

confidence.description: How strongly your source supports the inferred value.

field.description: Intake dot-path of the inferred value, matching the key you sent under `intake`, such as `address.zip`.

source.description: Free-form label for where the inferred value came from, such as `policy_declarations`, `email_thread`, or a property-data provider.

idempotency_key.description: Key you generate to identify one logical consumer_intake_patch request, so a retry cannot apply it twice. After a timeout or transport failure, retry with the same key and identical arguments to get the original result back; Coverage Cat keeps that result for 24 hours and rejects different arguments sent under a used key.

intake.description: Top-level intake edits. For umbrella, send only missing shopper-owned details, corrections, or canonical umbrella count fixes such as umbrella_details.motorized_vehicle_count. Do not send vehicles rows on this pre-submit patch.

current_auto_coverages.description: Which band the shopper's current underlying auto liability limits fall into: `500k/1m` covers $500k/$1 Million/$100k or higher; `500k/500k` covers $500k/$500k/$100k or $500k CSL; `300k/300k` covers $250k/$500k/$100k or $300k/$300k/$100k or $300k CSL; `100k/300k` covers $100k/$300k/$100k or lower. Pick the strongest band the shopper's actual limits fully satisfy. Underlying auto limits gate umbrella eligibility, so use `unsure` only when the shopper genuinely does not know their limits.

intake_access_token.description: Send the latest intake_access_token from the previous successful Coverage Cat response on each follow-up. Required for stateless MCP 2026-07-28 requests; also accepted by legacy hosts. Keep it private and never show it to the shopper.

message_reply.description: Homeowners post-submit only. Send the reply text Coverage Cat should deliver in-thread when consumer_intake_issues surfaced an insurer or shopper follow-up under conversation.messages.

reply_to_message_id.description: Homeowners post-submit message_id from conversation.messages[] that message_reply answers in-thread, when Coverage Cat returned a specific message to reply to.

uid.description: Coverage Cat intake uid returned by `umbrella_consumer_prefill` or `homeowners_consumer_prefill` and echoed on every follow-up response. Reuse it for each follow-up call on the same application.
